### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone
Problems: R = approve the sumatriptan QL renewal (agent; root); F = an undecided renewal request on file (member's own write); C = continuity-of-care authorization for the prior carrier's approval on file (agent); O = authorization owed for the overturned Ubrelvy appeal (agent).
- R <- F (**state-derived**): `quantity_limit_renewal_approval`: "The approved quantity of a quantity limit renewal is fixed only after the records carry an undecided renewal request for the drug." No renewal case on record; `member_filed_renewal_request`: "One filing opens one new undecided review case for the drug, recorded as a renewal".
- F <- C (**state-derived**): `member_filed_renewal_request`: "The quantity a member-filed renewal request asks for is not fixed until the records carry a continuity-of-care authorization for every prior carrier's approval on file for the drug." Records: case 4fa1fabc relies on the prior carrier's approval, no authorization exists. Search "continuity-of-care authorization" -> `continuity_of_care_quantity_authorization`: "One grant records one new quantity limit authorization for the drug that came about through continuity of care, linked to the member's case that carries the prior carrier's approval". Also the renewal doc renews "an authorization they hold".
- R <- O (**state-derived**): `other_acute_migraine_drug_on_renewal` (a document of R's own ceiling): "The approval ceiling of a quantity limit renewal is worked out only after the records carry the authorization owed for every appeal overturned on the other acute migraine drug." Other drug for sumatriptan = Ubrelvy; records: Ubrelvy appeal overturned 2026-10-05, no Ubrelvy authorization. Search "overturned" -> `appeal_overturn_quantity_authorization`: "the authorization owed for that overturned appeal is put in force for the drug".
Order: C -> F -> R, and O before R (O independent of C/F).
Why the root is a renewal and not a first-time exception: continuity is owed ("receives a continuity-of-care quantity limit authorization"; persona accepts "whatever coverage the plan owes"); once C is in force, a first-time QL request for sumatriptan meets decision rule 4 ("A request for a drug that already has an approval of the same type in force is denied with already approved unless it is a renewal inside the renewal window"), and the continuity doc requires "a regular approval before the continuity approval ends". So the regular approval is a renewal inside the 60-day window.
Counter-proof "do only the one thing asked": (i) file + approve a first-time exception without C — leaves the owed continuity authorization ungranted and, once granted, the first-time approval would collide with "At most ... one ... of the same type in force"; (ii) file + approve the renewal without O — the renewal ceiling's prerequisite sentence leaves it unworkable while the overturned Ubrelvy appeal has no authorization; (iii) file the renewal without C — no authorization to renew and its quantity not fixed. All excluded by visible sentences and records; no hop was handed over by a tool name, a route or a chain.
Factor findability: all factors reached from record words (case strength vs retail strength; HD opened_date; paper-claim denials; info-received ground prior_carrier_approval; auto_refill_enrolled + days supply; diagnosis code; oxycodone claims; Ubrelvy/sumatriptan fills; appeal level/filer/decision_reason; auth_basis continuity_of_care).
